description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter, which implements a custom type filter used to determine whether certain beans should be included or excluded based on OpenMRS profile attributes, such as version and module dependencies.

classes.name: OpenmrsProfileExcludeFilter
classes.description: Implements a Spring TypeFilter to exclude or include beans based on OpenMRS profile attributes, such as platform version and required modules.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines whether a given class should be included or excluded based on OpenMRS version and modules, using metadata reader information.

methods.name: matchOpenmrsProfileAttributes
methods.description: Evaluates the OpenMRS profile annotation attributes to decide if the current environment matches the specified criteria (version, modules).
